## Details

<a id="raster_irq"></a>
### [`raster_irq`](../../../../src/irq/raster_irq.asm#L6) `$4AC0`

*routine*

Raster IRQ through $0314. irq_phase $b0 selects the split: 0 = line $8a (ground colours), $ff = line $d2 (panel colours), 1 = line $01 (sky colour). Each split sets the next line.

- **Reads:** [`irq_phase`](../../memory-map.md#irq_phase)
- **Writes:** [`BGCOL0`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL0), [`BGCOL2`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL2), [`irq_phase`](../../memory-map.md#irq_phase), [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ)

| Label | Address | Comment |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="raster_irq_ground"></a>[`raster_irq_ground`](../../../../src/irq/raster_irq.asm#L21) | `$4AE0` | Phase 0, line $8a: background grey, multicolour 2 orange. |
| <a id="raster_irq_sky"></a>[`raster_irq_sky`](../../../../src/irq/raster_irq.asm#L32) | `$4AF8` | Phase 1, line $01: background light blue. |
| <a id="raster_irq_ack"></a>[`raster_irq_ack`](../../../../src/irq/raster_irq.asm#L41) | `$4B0B` | Acknowledges the raster IRQ. |
